this_is_a_post_audit_decision.what_the_audit_showed: the frozen structural head reaches 0.7013 overall accuracy but its bottleneck recall interval is 0.043 to 0.150 and its bottleneck NLL interval is 1.830 to 2.238, which is worse than a uniform three-class guess at 1.099
this_is_a_post_audit_decision.why_this_is_not_a_forbidden_repair: D-219, D-221 and D-222 forbid adding houses, changing the model or retuning thresholds so that the number improves; this decision does none of those. The estimator keeps its exact audited bytes, the audit report is never rerun, and the P08 fragment numbers are untouched. What changes is which public source certifies a route's structural role, and it changes because the audit falsified the premise that a single 90-degree frame can recover a 360-degree topological property.

root_cause.evidence_in_code: ops/vsmt/vm04_d217_rgbd_worker.py computes structural_label_from_reachable(reachable, position) once per position and appends the same label for all four yaws
root_cause.consequence: at a bottleneck position the frames whose yaw faces the wall carry no visible passage evidence yet carry the bottleneck label, so part of the training signal is unlearnable from its own input

this_is_bias_not_variance.reading: the model does not even fit its own training split beyond 0.71, so it is at an information or capacity ceiling and more houses cannot help

root_cause.cost_of_the_miss: the D-221 prefix extension generated 1664 extra houses to buy bottleneck coverage that this mismatch made unbuyable

change.what_p08_qualification_stops_using: the learned structural head probabilities as a gate
change.what_p08_qualification_starts_using: the already frozen D-215 topological rule, evaluated at route construction time on the public GetReachablePositions grid
change.why_zero: the predicate is not an approximation of the bottleneck definition, it is that definition; D-215 froze every constant it needs
change.required_signature: an ordered basin then bottleneck then basin run along the route, unchanged from D-214

method_basis: the public route survey takes the two fixed houses' public GetReachablePositions
the 0.5 m grid serves route planning on public reachable positions and local candidate recall only
permission_boundary.why_this_is_not_cheating: the original D-214 concern was that P08 must not be certified by private simulator room labels; GetReachablePositions is public geometry that route planning already consumes, and the memory methods still never see it

scope_reduction_that_must_be_reported.the_paper_may_no_longer_claim: that P08's structural role was publicly inferable from single-frame RGB-D
scope_reduction_that_must_be_reported.the_paper_may_claim: that the fixed P08 route genuinely has a basin bottleneck basin topology, certified by public reachable geometry at construction time

structural_head_disposition.reason_not_deleted: unlike the semantic head it remains deployable evidence: at inference the memory methods have only public RGB-D and cannot compute the topological rule, and the head's basin and unknown recall intervals of 0.731 to 0.781 and 0.673 to 0.727 still carry information

unchanged.entity_evidence_of_p08: the multi-view stable anonymous fragments that give P08 its unique scientific value never depended on the structural head and are untouched

retired_from_the_p08_gate.note: these two numbers governed a head that no longer gates anything; they are retired from the gate rather than retuned, and they are not replaced by different probability thresholds

anti_tuning.if_p08_still_fails_under_this_predicate: record construction failure and report it; do not weaken the predicate, do not change the route, do not change the house
